forum.title: LPDDR4 goes to EOF - Will STM32MP2 support LPDDR5?
forum.category: STM32 MPUs Products and hardware related
forum.best_answer_content:
Hello ​@Windows,

No, STM32MP2 will not support LPDDR5.

For us, LPDDR4 and even DDR3L are not in EOF.

Some partners can guarantee us some LPDDR4 and DDR3L provisioning.

BR,

Kevin
forum.content_text:
Both Micron and Samsung are putting LPDDR4 memories to EOF.

What is the guaranty that STM32MP2 can support other affordable memories e.g LPDDR5?
forum.author: Windows
